full_judgment: 3. The case of the opposite party is that the land comprises in Mouza Shahar Dhaka CS Khatian No. 3926, plot No. 150 area 0616 Ajutansha, originally belonged to Sree Mata Sarajani Daisha, who by registered deed No. 274 dated 11-1-1922 transferred the said land to Sreejukta Rudra Tridandi Tripur Linga Swami and thereafter Swamji transferred the same to plaintiff Bigraha by will and the executors filed a probate case in the Court of learned district Judge and got an order and was possessing the land through tenants and that the predecessor of petitioner and opposite party No. 2,was a ten-ant under them and to grab the said property he managed to get the SA record in his name in collusion with the employees of settlement office and the opposite party No. 1 on 31-12-1996 came to know that SA record of the suit land has been prepared in the name of predecessor of the petitioner and, as such, the opposite party No.  1 has filed Title Suit No. 240 of 1997 in the Court of the first Subordinate Judge, Dhaka for correction of record; that the predecessor of the petitioner is a defaulter in respect of payment of rent and, as such, the opposite party No. 1 has filed SCC Suit No. 20 of 1998 in the Court of the 6th Assistant Judge Dhaka for the eviction of the petitioners; that the petitioners were taking steps for construction of new building in the suit land after demolishing the old and dilapidated building and, as such, the opposite party No. 1 has filed Title Suit No. 37 of 1996 for permanent injunction and the said suit has been transferred to the Court 3rd Additional Assistant Judge, and has been renumbered as Title Suit No. 145 of 1997 and these 3 suits are pending 3 different Courts though the suit property and plaintiffs and defendants are same and, as such, all three suits should be heard by the learned Subordinate Judge, 1st Court Dhaka.
